iterations.description: ORIENT phase + axis splitting + docs-hypothesis (feature eval, cases 17-26)
iterations.with_rule: 8/10 PASS (80%) pre-fix; 10/10 (100%) after 6 fixes (re-run: 2 failed + 2 controls)
iterations.notes: Baseline unusually strong: preset names (onboarding, entryPoint) + typed filters self-describe. Skill value = deterministic ORIENT gate, codegraph-off degradation without unavailable presets, subagent availability signal. Pre-fix failures exposed Defect A: ORIENT unreachable for its own 'how is X organized' examples (intercepted by codegraph row 4); fixed by absorbing ORIENT into architecture-pattern Step 0.
